reasoning_trace.label: objective_fit
reasoning_trace.text: Goal is to have the victim execute the shortcut file without triggering spam filters or raising suspicion.

reasoning_trace.label: alternative

reasoning_trace.label: failure_mode
reasoning_trace.text: Links are analyzed by spam filters and security technologies, which may block or quarantine them before delivery.

reasoning_trace.label: decision
reasoning_trace.text: Choose WebDAV as it integrates with Windows Explorer, making the remote share appear as a local folder.

reasoning_trace.label: assumption
reasoning_trace.text: Assume that users are more likely to interact with files in a familiar directory view than with suspicious links.

reasoning_trace.label: observable
reasoning_trace.text: Observe that the path in Explorer shows only the library name, hiding the remote origin from the user.

reasoning_trace.label: operational_risk
reasoning_trace.text: Risk that the WebDAV share is writable, allowing AV to remove or quarantine the payload.

reasoning_trace.label: mitigation_or_guard
reasoning_trace.text: Use a separate Python server to serve the payload download, keeping the WebDAV share for the library file only.

reasoning_trace.label: verification
reasoning_trace.text: Test the full attack chain to confirm the library file opens the WebDAV share and the shortcut file executes properly.

reasoning_trace.label: transition
